exploit_name: Variable overwrite in checkPoolAndGetCenterPrice() creates dead-code deviation check
description: The function's return variable centerSqrtPriceX96 is initialized with the spot price but then overwritten with the TWAP-derived sqrt price. When computing deviation, both instantPrice and twapPrice derive from the same overwritten value, guaranteeing zero deviation. Early-return paths also return unprotected spot prices for stale or new pools.
attack_scenario: Attacker manipulates pool price, calls any LiquidityManager operation. Deviation check always passes (both values identical). Protocol provides liquidity at manipulated price.
root_cause: The function's return variable centerSqrtPriceX96 is initialized with the spot price but then overwritten with the TWAP-derived sqrt price. When computing deviation, both instantPrice and twapPrice derive from the same overwritten value, guaranteeing zero deviation. Early-return paths also return unprotected spot prices for stale or new pools.
fix_description: Preserve the original spot price before overwriting. Revert instead of returning unprotected prices for stale/new pools.
notes: All five LiquidityManager operations lack price manipulation protection. Concentrated liquidity positions can be exploited.
